title: SnipToss notes file sniptoss/5
description: The format of .sniptoss/annotations/*.json in a project; see docs/annotation-format.md. One file per item (or per folder). Unknown fields are allowed and are kept as they are when the app reads and rewrites the file. This schema describes what a file written by the app looks like; reading is more lenient (a missing anchor, replies, author or time is filled in), see "Reading rules" in the format document. One rule the schema cannot express: note ids must be unique within a file.

schema.description: Format version. Older versions pizhu/1–sniptoss/4 are converted when read: anchor.shape becomes an anchor.shapes with one entry. For sniptoss/6 and newer, this version of the app only reads and never writes

drawings.description: Optional (from 1.3.0): lines, arrows, freehand strokes and boxes drawn on the item without a note (no number, no comment). Drawn on the item and into the notes' snapshots on the same frame / page. Absent when there are none

material.description: What the notes refer to: one item, or a whole folder (kind = folder: every item inside, subfolders included)

path.description: Forward-slash path relative to the folder that contains .sniptoss; for a folder, "." = the folder that holds .sniptoss itself

kind.description: image | video | pdf | slides | folder (other kinds may be added later)

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the item when the first note was written (lowercase hex). Every note also records its own (material_sha256); the per-note value takes precedence, and older notes without one use this. Folders have none

width.description: Pixel width of the image or video

height.description: Pixel height of the image or video

frame_rate.description: Video only (from 1.3.0): frames per second, written only when the file has one constant frame rate (MP4 / MOV header). Frame n covers the times from n / frame_rate up to (n + 1) / frame_rate, counting from 0

pages.description: pdf / slides only: size of each page

id.description: The app generates 6 lowercase alphanumeric characters; agents use it to write a status back (sniptoss resolve <id>)

status.description: open = not handled yet | resolved = done | wontfix = won't fix

category.description: change = Change | remove = Remove | add = Add | question = Question

handed_off_at.description: Optional (since 2026-10-20): the time of the most recent copy out (Copy as Text, Copy as Images), ISO 8601; does not change updated_at

material_sha256.description: Optional: SHA-256 of the item when this note was written (lowercase hex); different from the item's current one = this note was written on an earlier version and its position is given by the snapshot (docs/annotation-format.md, "Notes written on an earlier version")

material_size.description: Optional (from 1.2.3): the item's size in bytes when this note was written, recorded with material_sha256. A note's material_sha256 is taken as the item's current hash without reading the file only while this matches the file's size (docs/annotation-format.md, "Notes on an earlier version")

color.description: Optional: a color set for this note's mark alone; absent = the mark color from Settings. Affects only how it is drawn, not the content of the comment

shape.description: One shape, as in a note's anchor.shapes; no color = the mark color from Settings

time.description: Video only: the frame it was drawn on, in seconds (may be a span like a note's)

page.description: pdf / slides only: page number, starting at 1

material_sha256.description: Optional: SHA-256 of the item when it was drawn; on a newer version of the item it is no longer drawn

anchor.description: Where the note sits on the item. All empty {} = a comment on the whole image / whole video / whole folder; on a video, one with only time is a timestamped comment

page.description: pdf / slides only: page number, starting at 1

time.description: Video only: seconds; no end when only a single time is marked

shapes.description: Which places this comment marks (since sniptoss/5; before that a single shape); the comment applies to every place; the order is the drawing order. Absent = no position given

unit.description: Normalized coordinate: 0–1, origin at the top-left corner (only the part inside the frame is recorded, so it is always within 0–1)

shape.description: Shape of a mark. An unknown type (a shape added later) is not an error; a reading program skips it and draws nothing

color.description: Optional: a color set for this place alone; absent = this note's color, and if that is absent too, the mark color from Settings. In files written by the app, every place carries a color when the places differ in color, and none does when they are all the same

breaks.description: A new segment starts at these indexes, not joined to the previous point (a stroke that leaves the frame and comes back)
